# googleworkspace_group (Resource)

A Google Workspace group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleworkspace_group" "engineers" {
  email       = "engineers@example.com"
  name        = "Engineers"
  description = "Engineering team distribution list"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The group's primary email address.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `name` (String) Display name of the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Immutable group ID. Used for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Groups are imported by their immutable group ID (from the data source or Admin SDK).
terraform import googleworkspace_group.engineers 01234567890abcde
```
